description: Restart of exp531 with residual tph 256->1024 at nap=4. This is PARAM-MATCHED to exp530 (nap=4/tph=1024: 16*1024=16384 entries/table = nap=6/tph=256: 64*256=16384; both 108.3M). Clean wide-shallow-vs-deep test for the residual decoder at fixed entry budget. exp531 (nap=4/tph=256, smaller) trailed exp530 by ~12mb; this isolates shape from capacity. vs exp530 1.4731 (nap=6/tph=256), exp513 1.4825.
